rows.nearest_text_preview: The complainant reports that a male supervisor demanded a sexual favour from a woman in exchange for approving her request. She refused and reported the demand.
The complainant reports that a male coworker deliberately showed pornography to a woman after she said she did not want to see it. She reported that the display was against her will.
Main ek mahila employee hoon. Mere supervisor ne kai baar mujhse sexual favour maanga aur kaha promotion tabhi milega. Maine mana kiya; uske baad bhi usne wahi demand messages mein bheji.

मैं एक महिला कर्मचारी हूँ। मेरे पुरुष प्रबंधक ने कहा कि नौकरी में आगे बढ़ने के लिए मुझे उसकी यौन मांग माननी होगी। मैंने साफ मना किया, फिर भी उसने वही बात लिखकर दो बार भेजी। मेरे पास दोनों संदेश सुरक्षित हैं।
Someone secretly recorded me while I was changing clothes in a private changing room. I never consented to the recording, and he later sent the video to another person.
Someone secretly recorded me while I was changing clothes in a private changing room. I never consented to the recording, and he later sent the video to another person.
Main kapde badal rahi thi ek band changing room mein. Ek aadmi ne chhupkar darwaze ke gap se mera video banaya. Maine recording ki kabhi permission nahi di aur room private tha.

किसी व्यक्ति ने मेरा लॉगिन पासवर्ड बिना पूछे इस्तेमाल करके मेरे खाते में प्रवेश किया और मेरे नाम से कई लोगों को संदेश भेजे। मंच के लॉग में उसके अलग उपकरण का समय दिखता है। मैंने पासवर्ड साझा नहीं किया था।
I am a woman. A man from my class has followed me home on four evenings and keeps contacting me after I clearly told him not to. I have saved the messages.
I told a man several times that I did not want any contact with him. He continues following me to work, waiting outside my house and monitoring my social-media activity.
Main ek mahila hoon. Maine use saaf kaha ki mujhe contact na kare, lekin woh aadmi teen hafte se roz office tak mera peecha karta hai. Maine dates likhi hain aur guard ne bhi dekha.

मुझे ऑनलाइन किसी ने बैंक कर्मचारी बनकर लिखा कि मेरा खाता बंद होगा और एक लिंक पर भुगतान करना होगा। मैंने उसकी झूठी पहचान पर भरोसा करके रकम भेज दी। बाद में बैंक ने बताया कि वह व्यक्ति उनका कर्मचारी नहीं है।

A person sent me one unwanted message. There has been no repeated contact or monitoring that I know of.
